messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem thread — we need to finalize the customer-facing materials and decide our RCA sharing policy. Main asks: status page wording, 72h customer summary, and whether we publish a full RCA or provide a redacted/public summary. I pasted the postmortem action list below.

jamal: +1. Who's taking the lead on the customer note?

sophia: I can draft the 72h summary. Can someone lock the statuspage sentence so I can reference it? Also we should get legal on redaction guidance.

alana: I can propose a short statuspage blurb. My draft: "We experienced elevated latency affecting text generation API between 02:15–03:10 UTC. Root cause: KV cache eviction triggered during a model rollout; mitigation applied via rollback. Full postmortem to follow." Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jamal: That reads well and is concise. Add an explicit line if applicable: "No customer data was compromised." Can someone confirm that?

samir: Security confirms no data exfiltration observed. We can include the sentence.

devops-bot: Incident postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-03-22  (automated)

maria: Good. Proposal for sharing policy: public summary + offer full RCA to customers on request, with NDAs/DPA as needed for enterprise. Alternatively, a tiered approach: short public summary, expanded customer brief for affected customers, and full internal RCA only on a per-request basis.

jamal: I prefer the tiered model. Keeps the public page short and prevents premature disclosure. Action items we should call out now:
- Sophia: draft 72h customer summary (due by 2312345760)
- Alana: propose final statuspage wording (due by 2312345725)
- Devina (legal): confirm redaction/sharing policy (due by 2312345800)
- Samir: security checklist and confirmation note (due by 2312345790)
- Maria: approve & publish final note once reviews complete (due by 2312345810)

devops-bot: Action created: ACTION-4521 assigned to sophia, due 2312345760

devina: Legal POV — prefer a redacted public RCA initially. We can release full technical RCAs to enterprise customers under an NDA or with a DPA addendum. Please send a redaction proposal (list of items to remove) and we'll review. I'll aim to respond by EOD tomorrow.

alana: Updated statuspage snippet suggestion: "We experienced elevated latency affecting text generation API between 02:15–03:10 UTC. Root cause: cache eviction during a model rollout. We have mitigated the issue and rolled back the rollout. No customer data was compromised. A full postmortem will be published when redaction review is complete."

jamal: That looks good. :thumbsup: One small ask — can we include a single-sentence mitigation note (what we did to stop it) as you have.

samir: Confirmed from security side: no evidence of data leak, and the mitigation (rollback + temporary throttling) was effective.

sec-bot: Security scan complete — no exfiltration detected.

maria: OK. Sophia, when you draft the 72h summary, include an FAQ section: top 4 customer questions and short answers. Example Qs: "Was my data affected?", "What caused the outage?", "When will this be fixed for good?", "What are you doing to prevent recurrence?"

sophia: Will do. I'll include the FAQ and a short timeline. Also: for enterprise outreach, I need Sales help to identify the affected accounts. @jamal can you loop in the account list?

jamal: I'll export the affected-customer list and DM Sophia.

maria: Recurring pattern note: we flagged similar KV eviction-related latency spikes in the Jan postmortem. We should add a follow-up to eng-runtime to implement guardrails to prevent massive eviction during rollouts. Niko, can your team own a mitigation ticket?

niko: Yep — eng-runtime will add a guardrail ticket and target a fix in the next sprint. I'll attach the ticket number once created.

maria: Perfect. To recap and close the loop:
- Publish updated statuspage blurb now (Alana to finalize and ProdOps to push)
- 72h public/customer summary drafted by Sophia, reviewed by Legal (Devina), Security (Samir), and Product (Maria)
- Enterprise outreach handled by Sophia + Sales after review
- Eng-runtime (Niko) to add infra guardrail ticket to backlog to address recurring KV eviction pattern

maria: I'll update the RCA-sharing policy doc after Legal confirms the redaction list. Thanks everyone — please react with :white_check_mark: when your part is done and add any blockers here.

sophia: Drafting now, will post a first pass in this thread by EOD (2312345760).

alana: Final statuspage wording posted to #statuspage-drafts, pinging ProdOps for deployment.

devina: Reviewing redaction list now. Expect reply within 24h.

samir: Security sign-off added to the draft.

niko: Added an initial mitigation ticket to eng-runtime backlog and set priority to P1 for the guardrail.

maria: Thanks — closing this thread for now, will reopen if any new blocker comes up. :wave:
